Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
angel wrote:
> anyway rules question:
> 1) haven uncovered:
> if A puts haven on B (B is not the prey or predator). B trys to burn
> the haven:
> i) does A get to intercept automatically
> and ii) is it at +1 intercept to match the +1 stealth??

?
The action to burn a card is directed at the controller of the card (or
is undirected if the controller is the same as the controller of the
acting minion). In this case, the action is directed at the controller of
the Haven: A.
As a directed action, only A's minions can attempt to block.
The attempts are not automatically successful.
The attempt is at +1 stealth, and for any block to be successful, the
blocker must have intercept greater than or equal to the acting minion's
stealth.

> 2) living manse:
> is this errated to say 'unique location' ?

No.

> 3) catatonic fear:
> whats the correct card text ?

Combat. Presence.
Inferior: Strike: Combat Ends.
Superior: As above, and the opposing minion takes 1 damage (after combat
ends).

> 4) vp's:
> two players left (A+B)
> A calls autarktis persecution (ie all players lose 5 pool) - this
> would oust himself and B
> i) does this happen simultaneoulsy?

Yes.

> ii) who gets what victory points? ie does A get one for B and one for
> last person on the table or do they both just get one VP or do they
> get no VPs ???

Rulebook: "If a player is ousted at the same time that her prey is ousted,
the player gets the ante and victory point but does not gain six pool."

They both get a VP for ousting their respective preys.
